module: Flowgraph node "Set UI Layout" (category once_instant): changes the layout of the UI apps via self.mgr.modules.ui:setGameState. Inputs: flow, "reset" (allows retriggering), "layout" (name or layoutData table), "menu", "keepLayout" (keeps the layout after the graph stops), "gameStateName" (hidden), "appContainerContext" (topCenter container app to display, hidden). Output: flow.
notes: If the 'restrictScenarios' setting is disabled, the 'freeroam' menu is forced (warning message).
The layout/menu template lists are empty (call to ui_apps.getLayouts commented out).
afterTrigger is written without an underscore, so it is never called by the engine: active (used by onUiChangedState) never becomes true.
In onClientPostStartMission, 'menuState' is not defined in this function (nil global variable).

afterTrigger.desc: Sets active according to the input flow (name without underscore: probably never called).

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook: reapplies the layout after the level starts.

onUiChangedState.desc: Hook: UI state change (cur, prev); in 'quickraceScenario' mode in the menu, triggers setQuickRaceMode and HotlappingResetApp.

postInit.desc: Fills the layout, menu and appContainerContext templates.

workOnce.desc: Applies the game state (layout/menu) and displays the requested container app.
